english.note: Use this specifically when someone reads other people’s feelings, motives, or character accurately.

examples.english: Ming is perceptive when it comes to people and spotted right away that person was unreliable.
examples.traditional: 阿明睇人好準，一早就睇出嗰個人唔可靠。
